purpose: Prospectively test whether the direction-dependent cancellation between MLP8's exact invariant base-by-change and change-by-change response terms generalizes to fronted two-attractor Task14 syntax, and score the algebraically equivalent selective-removal contrasts.
novelty_verdict: Novel MLP8 intervention on previously opened OOD text. This is not pristine OOD data and cannot support a pristine-data claim.

prior_art.finding: On licensed matched text, plural-to-singular changes had a strongly positive cross term and negative quadratic term, while singular-to-plural changes reversed those roles. The terms largely cancelled. OOD syntax and necessity were closed.
The exact OOD fronted text and whole-head/QK outcomes are already open. Native base and donor accuracy was 1.0 in both directions. No MLP8 response polarization was run.
Frozen generator for the OOD A1 fronted-two-attractor rows.
Audited numerical implementation of the exact MLP8 polarization; this successor must reuse its float64 local algebra, native endpoints, native-dtype installation, and sequential propagation.

authority.selection: OOD A1 group numbers 0-7 and 16-23, chosen without MLP8 outcomes; two rows per direction by two-attractor-number state

capability.policy: A new candidate-scoped native-only result and license must pass before any causal intervention. Six direction-by-role cells each contain eight endpoints and require at least 0.875 native accuracy.
capability.reuse_limit: The fresh-matched license is forbidden; aggregate open OOD accuracy is prior evidence only and is not substituted for the scoped per-endpoint capability result.

exact_computation.input: At subject position 8, xr and xd are the actual normalized MLP8 inputs for the recipient and matched opposite-number prompt; dx=xd-xr.
exact_computation.cross: (Left(dx) * Right(xr)) + (Left(xr) * Right(dx)), with the fixed numerical remainder assigned prospectively as in v2.
exact_computation.output: Apply MLP8 Down, propagate sequentially through native block-9/10/11 residual coefficients, replace only the MLP8 slot feeding the established L11H3 current-value branch, and retain recipient attention probabilities, cached values, and non-subject source terms.
exact_computation.gauge_limit: Only cross and quadratic are scientific units; ordered Left-only and Right-only terms are not semantic claims.

backgrounds.conditional: Other MLP4-7 and MLP9-10 slots use the opposite-number donor.
backgrounds.lexical: Other MLP4-10 slots remain recipient and MLP8 receives a same-number different-lemma source.

frozen_predictions.pred_a_instrument_live: Exactness passes and full MLP8 improves both target margin and target CE with at least 0.75 helpful rows in every direction and both causal backgrounds.
frozen_predictions.pred_b_plural_to_singular_cross_positive: For CE and margin in both backgrounds, cross recovery is at least 1.5 and quadratic recovery is at most -0.5.
frozen_predictions.pred_c_singular_to_plural_cross_negative: For CE and margin in both backgrounds, cross recovery is at most -0.1 and quadratic recovery is at least 1.1.
frozen_predictions.pred_d_signed_direction_pattern: Both opposing signed direction predictions hold.
frozen_predictions.pred_e_background_stable: Every cross/quadratic recovery changes by at most 0.25 between standalone and conditional backgrounds.
frozen_predictions.pred_f_number_specific: Every same-number lexical full-effect ratio is at most 0.25.
frozen_predictions.pred_g_selective_removal_direction_patte: In the conditional donor-other-MLP background, plural-to-singular removal of cross hurts and removal of quadratic helps; singular-to-plural reverses those roles. This is algebraically dependent on the same four corners and is not independent evidence.

opposing_outcomes.direction_general: All signed predictions hold in both CE and margin.
opposing_outcomes.syntax_or_lexeme_specific: Any required direction/background/outcome violates its signed threshold while the instrument remains live.
opposing_outcomes.no_usable_test: The scoped native capability, exactness, or full-MLP8 live gate fails.

selective_removal_definition.remove_cross: conditional_full minus conditional_quadratic-corner; the quadratic corner equals the full donor MLP8 output with the cross response removed.
selective_removal_definition.remove_quadratic: conditional_full minus conditional_cross-corner; the cross corner equals the full donor MLP8 output with the quadratic response removed.
selective_removal_definition.dependence_warning: These are deterministic contrasts of the same factorial corners, not a second independent experiment.
